# Test fixtures

Real-world and reference UDDF files, vendored from
[divejson/divejson](https://github.com/divejson/divejson) (MIT) at commit
`3c65bace8d43178017d2dad0446a7c0d5a2d2c99`:

- `*.uddf` come from its `fixtures/uddf/`: reductions of exports by Subsurface, Shearwater
  Cloud Desktop, divelogs.de, a legacy 2.x writer and the DiveJSON reference writer.
- `write/*.uddf` come from its `fixtures/write/uddf/`: files the DiveJSON UDDF writer
  produces.

Copy them unchanged when updating, and record the new commit here.
